jsia_2023_background_paragraph_1: I participated to the Journée Scientifique autour de l'IA (JSIA), a one day event organized by the University of Lorraine and taking place in on the 28th of February 2023 in Nancy, France. I was invited to present a poster showcasing my early thesis research. The poster showcases a workflow intended to process multiplexed immunohistochemistry images (mIHC) using a deep-learning network called Color-AE-UNet that I attenpted to apply to a more complex set of multiplex immunofluorescence images (mIF).
